items.title: Trump announces a deal for Hamas to disarm, but many hurdles and uncertainty remain
items.description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its forces from Gaza. But many hurdles, conditions and long timelines remain to wind down the war in the Palestinian territory.

items.title: Why a MAGA influencer’s shift to support Ukraine war is good for Trump
items.description: One of the most prominent pro-Trump influencers, Laura Loomer, just made a major shift in her stance on Ukraine.

items.title: Trump claims Hamas disarmament plan reached by Board of Peace
items.description: US President Donald Trump says his Board of Peace has reached an agreement for the 'complete disarmament' of Hamas, which the militant group has confirmed, with Israel yet to comment.

items.title: Russian missiles interception rate in Ukraine dropped from 90% back in March to 70%, expert says
items.description: A Russian ballistic missile and drone barrage across Ukraine overnight killed at least 10 civilians, including children. Ukraine's air force said it had managed to intercept 55 missiles and 265 drones launched by Moscow -- but it has struggled to intercept the advanced ballistic missiles that Russia is increasingly dep…

items.title: Are Iran and Ukraine wars getting tangled in Caspian Sea?
items.description: Tehran has threatened a response after a Ukrainian strike on an Iranian cargo ship in the Caspian Sea that Kyiv says was carrying weapons to Russia. Still, Ukraine says it wants to avoid escalation with Tehran.

items.title: 'Get Off The Bus, Get Out Of The Country.' Ukrainians Took Refuge In Poland. Now They're Increasingly Fearful.
items.description: Ukrainians who've taken refuge in Poland from the Russian invasion say they’re increasingly under threat, targeted by xenophobic, racist attacks. The fears come as tensions between Kyiv and Warsaw fester due to grievances dating back to World War II.

items.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
items.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

items.title: Writing on Wall for Putin in D.C.
items.description: Timothy Ash argues that Washington’s growing bipartisan support for tougher Russia sanctions, Ukraine’s battlefield gains and drone warfare edge are shifting the dynamics of the war. He says mounting pressure could push Vladimir Putin toward negotiations as the Kremlin faces rising economic and military challenges.

items.title: At Least 3 Dead in Russia and Crimea After Ukraine Strikes Industrial Sites
items.description: Ukraine claimed its armed forces hit multiple oil refineries, a logistics center and other sites connected to the Russian military.

items.title: How Ukraine’s long-range drones are changing what’s possible in war with Russia
items.description: The latest story of the Ukraine war has been the shift – on the battlefield, and in the adversaries’ minds – wrought by Ukraine’s drone strikes deep into Russia. The goal is to pave a path to a diplomatic resolution.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Updates on Gaza, West Bank amid regional tensions
items.description: Regional tensions are mounting as the US-Iran war continues and a rising number of Israeli attacks are threatening Gaza’s fragile October ceasefire that ended two years of war with Hamas. Security Council members heard briefings followed by an open debate on Tuesday. UN News app users click here for live coverage.
